summary: Suzhou SEMC Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of wet process equipment for the semiconductor industry. The company focuses on applications in wafer substrate materials, compound semiconductors, SAW devices, IGBTs, MEMS, and advanced packaging, offering comprehensive support throughout the equipment lifecycle.
